title: agentest trace format
description: One OTLP/JSON TracesData document (or a LogsData document carrying records, D8) (one export; OTLP/JSON encoding of the OpenTelemetry trace data model) with the attribute types agentest reads. Attribute names follow the OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions pinned in semconv.yaml, plus the agentest.* names listed in x-agentest-attributes. Every attribute is optional unless its requirement says otherwise: a check whose attribute is missing reports n/a, never pass. Unknown attributes are allowed and ignored. The reader (agentest.standards.otel) is more lenient than this schema: it also accepts the older and alternative names in semconv.yaml. Draft: see docs/TRACE-FORMAT.md.
x-agentest-status: approved 18 Nov 2026 (D1-D9); PR is a draft until merged

gen_ai.operation.name.type: string: invoke_agent | execute_tool | chat | text_completion | generate_content

agentest.replay.of.type: string (trace id of the original run)

agentest.api.response_status.type: string: ok | partial | malformed | invalid | truncated

agentest.a2a.message_type.type: string: request | accept | result | subgoal | handoff | escalation

agentest.data.operation.type: string: read | write | update | delete | create

agentest.task.dsar_sla_s.type: double, or JSON object by type

agentest.fault.kind.type: string: timeout | error | malformed | hostile | env_change | overload | fuzz | exploit

agentest.alert.type: record: span, span event or log record
agentest.alert.where: span, span event or log record
